name: Bio Landhaus Seethaler
beschreibung: The Bio Landhaus Seethaler in Thiersee is an eco-friendly country hotel devoted to organic farming principles and sustainable tourism. The guest rooms are tastefully furnished with natural materials, boasting delightful views of the surrounding mountains. Each morning, guests can savour wholesome regional organic produce at breakfast. Its idyllic setting close to Lake Thiersee provides fantastic opportunities for hiking, cycling, and refreshing lake swimming. In the winter season, nearby ski resorts are within easy reach. The hotel also features a soothing wellness area with a sauna to unwind after outdoor adventures.
